description: Published in a game's own repository to revoke compromised, exploited, or mistakenly signed achievement unlocks, leaderboard scores, or match results.

main.description: First-party publisher revocation record requiring zero separate Labeler infrastructure. Complements ATProto Labelers (`com.atproto.label.defs#label`, used for third-party/community anti-cheat & replay moderation) and `leaderboard.definition#rankedVersions` (preferred over `before` cutoffs for clean balance/chart version resets). For `scope: "attestation"`, set `rkey` to `attestationCid` for O(1) lookup via `com.atproto.repo.getRecord`. Deleting this record reinstates the revoked attestation(s).

scope.description: `attestation` revokes a single signed payload identified by `attestationCid`; `achievement`, `leaderboard`, `match`, `challenge`, or `game` revokes all signed records for `player` matching `subject` (optionally bounded by `before`).

attestationCid.description: Deterministic DAG-CBOR CIDv1 (`bafy...`) of the signed payload being revoked. Required when `scope` is `attestation`. Binding revocation to `attestationCid` rather than only `recordUri` prevents a player from re-uploading the same signed record under a different `rkey`.

player.description: DID of the player whose signed record(s) are revoked.

subject.description: AT-URI of the `achievement.definition`, `leaderboard.definition`, `challenge.definition`, or `games.atmosphere.define` record in this publisher's repository to which the revocation applies.

recordUri.description: Optional AT-URI of the offending `achievement.unlock`, `leaderboard.score`, or `match.result` record observed in the player's repository, preserved for auditability.

before.description: Optional cutoff timestamp for `achievement`, `leaderboard`, `match`, `challenge`, or `game` scopes. Note: for non-adversarial chart or balance updates, prefer `leaderboard.definition#rankedVersions` so historical runs stay preserved rather than revoked.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason code for the revocation.

note.description: Optional human-readable explanation written by the game publisher.

revokedAt.description: Timestamp when this revocation was published.
